findings.finding: Family conflict and Nephi’s prayer precede separation. Verse25 recalls spiritual experiences on high mountains; it does not locate the later temple.

Departure through wilderness, tents, place named Nephi, crops and livestock, building and woodworking/metallurgy, fine Solomon-pattern temple with fewer precious things. No coordinates, temple hill, exactdimensions or complete material list. Abundant ores in15 must be retained alongside qualification in16; no blanket claim that precious metals were absent.
Jacob’s teaching, Isaiah and Israel’s covenant future. No new temple building or local terrain description.

Jacob teaches in temple after Nephi’s death; repeated up-language makes elevated approach compatible, but does not prove hill elevation/shape. Identifying this as continuing use of Nephi’s temple is natural narrative inference, not a preserved architectural survey.

Noah’s later building/ornamentation: fine wood/copper/brass inside temple, gold highpriests’ seats and breastwork. Verse12 tower near temple;13 separately describes a tower on hill north of Shilom. Do not identify those as the same location or backdate additions to Nephi without evidence.

Mosiah leaves land of Nephi for Zarahemla; later return expeditions precede Zeniff’s resettlement of Lehi-Nephi/Shilom. These geographic/chronological changes prevent treating every temple passage as one unchanged building. Noah’s temple may preserve/replace earlier building; these passages do not settle its fabric continuity.

Solomon’s house: rectangular plan, porch, windows, surrounding chambers, prepared stone, timber roof/paneling, gold overlay; bronze pillars/sea/lavers in7. Chapter7:1–12 also describes palace buildings: do not transfer their100x50dimensions to temple. Solomon’s details guide illustration, not automatic proof Nephi copied every material or furnishing.
Jerusalem location MountMoriah/Zion and elevated innercourt described; these are Solomon’s geographic facts, not a named NewWorld hill for Nephi.
